title: Mise
subtitle: Three staff. Two hobs. A full house.
description: Arrange a miniature bistro, prepare real ingredients and direct three model-coordinated staff through a three-sitting service. Manage shared stations, recipe dependencies, heat, quality and ticket deadlines in deliberate kitchen pulses.
instruction: Arrange and prep before service. Inspect tickets, set priorities and hob heat, then call the crew for one bounded service beat. A connected model coordinates staff; local rules decide every dish.
